items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I'm going to come out to the famous door and play with the Dukes... get Buck Rogers. And they got Buck

ctx.x: I knew Buck is the one.

Yeah, well Buck took my place. You see, this is recently. I compare it to the recent, at the famous door, see. There are two bands there. I remember Santa and the old man Christian. You know what I mean. It's a drum one place, see. I said, well, I didn't need anybody to call me up and all that. I said, so I went home from the barbershop and the phone and it was him. I'm going to come out to the famous door and play with the Dukes, you know. I said, what happened to Rod? I said, heart attack. Quiet, when I heard…
Well, Emmett Rogers was different from Buck, huh?
